verification.detail: Kernel executed on Model/Ascend950PR_9599, verification passed

notes: Golden kernel verified on the CANN 9.0.0 simulator (Ascend950PR_9599 / C310 / arch35) in Docker via tests/tools/run_and_verify.py --mode simulator, on the ARM64 pyasc build (the merge-gate runner). NB: the amd64 pyasc build lacks bf16 IR lowering (asc/language/core/dtype.py to_ir() has no bfloat16 -> get_bf16_type factory and raises 'Unsupported DataType name: bfloat16'), so bfloat16 goldens are verifiable on arm64 only; the merge-gate runs on the self-hosted arm64 runner for this reason. High-level LayerNorm (mean subtraction + beta) with full_row and split_d kernels plus a host-side N-D flatten dispatcher: any N-D input flattens on the host to [rows, last_dim] and normalizes over the last axis. bf16 input/output with float32 accumulator: loaded tiles cast via .to(asc.float32), output cast back via .to(x.dtype) before asc2.store. Variance computed as E[x^2] - mean^2 (merged sum_x + sum_x2 pass) so host zero padding does not bias the statistics. Inputs are torch.Tensor (numpy is silently zeroed on the C310 path). Verified shapes (8, 4096) [full_row] and (8, 1024) [full_row] against torch.nn.functional.layer_norm.
